question: Should `sessions_send` universally reject any route that revisits an earlier agent, including intentionally designed return-to-agent workflows, rather than retain only the existing pairwise turn limit?
rationale: The proposed behavior is not merely a mechanical repair: it adds a new fail-closed routing policy for all agent-to-agent chains, and current evidence does not establish that all legitimate revisit patterns should be prohibited.

options.title: Adopt no-revisit cycle blocking
options.body: Accept the proposed invariant, then require fresh current-main proof and a clear error chain before merge.

options.title: Use a narrower routing policy
options.body: Keep the existing pairwise limit as default and define a more targeted policy or explicit opt-in for graph-cycle blocking.

recommendation.title: Adopt no-revisit cycle blocking
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed invariant, then require fresh current-main proof and a clear error chain before merge.
